description: TRANSFER LEARNING FROM DIBCO BEST MODEL (epoch 105, PSNR 21.75 dB) TO ANRI REAL PALEOGRAPHIC DATASET. Source: DIBCO synthetic degradation (256 samples, PSNR 21.75 dB). Target: ANRI real 16-18th century handwritten documents (~1200 samples). Strategy: Fine-tuning with conservative LR, strong regularization, domain adaptation for paleographic complexity. Goal: Adapt synthetic-trained model to handle real historical document degradation patterns (ink bleeding, severe aging, paleographic handwriting).

experiment_metadata.methodology: Transfer learning from DIBCO best model to ANRI real paleographic dataset
experiment_metadata.architecture: Enhanced Generator + Enhanced V2 Fixed Discriminator
experiment_metadata.novelty: First transfer learning from synthetic DIBCO to real 16-18th century paleographic documents
experiment_metadata.training_strategy: Conservative fine-tuning with strong regularization for domain adaptation

transfer_context.domain_gap: Synthetic vs Real, Modern vs 16-18th century, Printed vs Handwritten
transfer_context.adaptation_challenge: Real ink bleeding, severe aging, paleographic handwriting complexity

target_dataset.name: ANRI Real Paleographic
target_dataset.complexity: HIGH - real paleographic handwriting, severe degradation

fine_tuning_strategy.batch_size: Small (2) to avoid overfitting on smaller dataset
fine_tuning_strategy.early_stopping: Patient (15) due to higher task complexity
fine_tuning_strategy.curriculum: 20 epochs annealing (longer warmup for domain shift)

learning_rate.rationale: Smaller dataset, avoid overfitting, gentler domain adaptation

dropout.rationale: Stronger regularization for smaller dataset, prevent overfitting

early_stopping_patience.rationale: Allow more exploration due to domain gap and higher complexity

perceptual_loss_weight.rationale: Gradient stabilization, avoid spikes on different domain

rec_feat_loss_weight.rationale: Gradient stabilization, consistent with perceptual reduction

gradient_clip_norm.rationale: Prevent gradient explosion on unfamiliar data distribution

annealing_epochs.rationale: Longer curriculum for gradual domain adaptation

expected_challenges.domain_shift: Synthetic DIBCO degradation vs real historical degradation
expected_challenges.complexity_increase: Modern printed text vs paleographic handwriting
expected_challenges.data_scarcity: 256 DIBCO samples vs ~1200 ANRI (but ANRI more varied)
expected_challenges.quality_metrics: PSNR may be lower due to higher task difficulty
expected_challenges.overfitting_risk: HIGH - real data more varied, less samples per degradation type

success_criteria.ambitious: PSNR ≥ 21.0 dB (match DIBCO performance on real data)
success_criteria.visual_quality: Legible text, preserved paleographic features, minimal artifacts
success_criteria.htr_improvement: CER reduction ≥ 10% on degraded vs restored

expected_results.validation_psnr: 18.0-21.0 dB (lower than DIBCO due to real data complexity)
expected_results.training_time: ~3-4 hours (100 epochs max, expect early stop ~35-40)

risk_mitigation.overfitting: Dropout 0.4, small LR, early stopping patience 15
risk_mitigation.domain_gap: Conservative LR (50% reduction), long annealing (20 epochs)
risk_mitigation.poor_performance: If PSNR < 16.0 at epoch 20 → consider further LR reduction or freeze encoder
risk_mitigation.catastrophic_forgetting: Monitor validation loss, if diverges → restore checkpoint and reduce LR

critical_checkpoints: Epoch 5: Check warmup stability (no NaN, loss decreasing)
stop_conditions: Early stopping triggered (15 epochs no improvement)
PSNR plateau < 16.0 dB for 10 epochs (poor domain adaptation)
intervention_triggers: Epoch 10: PSNR < 15.0 → reduce LR to 0.000003, increase gradient clip to 10.0
Epoch 20: PSNR < 17.0 → freeze encoder layers, only train decoder
Epoch 30: PSNR decreasing → restore best checkpoint, reduce LR by 50%

anri_target.quality_gap: Expected 1-3 dB lower due to real data complexity

validation_strategy.rationale: Focus on image quality restoration, HTR is separate downstream task
validation_strategy.test_data: finetuning_test.tfrecord (~150-200 real images, held out for final evaluation)

metrics: CER, WER (HTR accuracy on degraded vs restored)
comparison: Degraded input vs Restored output (quality improvement)
DIBCO test set vs ANRI test set (domain transfer effectiveness)
Baseline (no restoration) vs GAN restoration (HTR improvement)
